newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Pak Suzuki Motor up 5.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Pak Suzuki Motor up 5.0 pct.

text.p: Pak Suzuki Motor rose 2.0 rupees, or 5.0 percent, to 42 rupees on Tuesday on expectations of healthy results, dealers said.

"People are very optimistic about the results of Pak Suzuki Motor as the company has done good business," dealer Ather Raouf said. "People expect a good dividend and there is little liquidity in the stock at present ahead of the board meeting."
Pak Suzuki Motor's board is due to meet on Thursday to consider accounts for the financial year ended June 30.
A turnover of 8,000 shares had been recorded by mid-session on the Karachi bourse.
